limitations: Online Esri basemap layers remain service-backed; local vectors and Daymet rasters are packaged.
No graticule was added; coordinate decoration was omitted rather than approximated.
Original master APRX was not modified.
Saved exports have fixed hashes. Re-exported live Esri basemaps may differ as service content changes.
The exporter resolves packaged editable picture sources relative to the APRX before export.
Map export uses a short-lived ArcPy child; extraction cleanup occurs after that process exits and releases Windows layer locks.
